title: I don't want to go outside yet.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: It's time to put on your shoes so we can go.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I don't want to go outside yet.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: But we are already late, you know.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Can I have five more minutes, please?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You can have two more minutes, and then shoes go on first.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Can I wear my boots instead? I don't want to bend down to tie shoes.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Boots it is, then. You have two minutes, and then we go.

variations: "go" 换 "get dressed"；"bend down" 换 "tie laces"。
